notes: Eval set for the planner/builder/reviewer/reviser pipeline. Keep prompts phrased the way a real user would pitch them — vague ones included on purpose. `expect.artifact` drives which mechanical checks run; `expect.keywords` are case-insensitive substrings that must appear somewhere in the extracted code for the output to count as on-spec.
